declarations.description:
One conversation on a piece of content, like a comment in Google Docs, a review thread on GitHub or a comment pin in
Figma: the first comment and its replies, a reply box, edit and delete on your own comments, and Resolve.

`comments` lists the thread oldest first: the first is the root, the rest its replies. Each has an `author`, a plain
text `body` (line breaks kept, `@mentions` highlighted, never read as HTML), a `time`, and optionally `reactions` for
a `c2-reaction-bar` under it (shown with `reactions`). `quote` shows the text the thread is about. `current-user`
says who is writing: their own comments can be edited and deleted, and without one the thread is read-only. A thread
with more than `collapse-after` replies folds its middle behind "Show N earlier replies"; a `resolved` thread folds
down to its first comment.

Every change is a cancelable event fired before it is applied: `comment-add`, `comment-edit`, `comment-delete`,
`resolve-change` and `reaction-change`. Cancel one to keep the thread controlled (to wait for the server) and set
`comments` yourself. An added comment that is not cancelled gets a temporary id (`local-1`). Deleting the first
comment only fires `comment-delete`: removing the thread is the app's.

members.name: comments
members.description: The thread, oldest first. As an attribute, a JSON array of `{ id, author, body, time, edited?, reactions? }`.

members.name: currentUser
members.description: Who is writing, as `{ id?, name, avatar? }`. Their comments can be edited and deleted. Without one, the thread is read-only.

members.name: quote
members.description: The text the thread is about, shown as a quote above the first comment.

members.name: resolved
members.description: Whether the thread is resolved: it folds down to its first comment.

members.name: reactions
members.description: Shows a reaction bar under each comment.

members.name: collapseAfter
members.description: Past this many replies (at least 3), only the first and the last two show until "Show N earlier replies" is pressed.

members.name: readonly
members.description: No reply box, edit, delete or resolve.

members.name: label
members.description: The accessible name of the thread.

members.name: editing
members.description: The comment being edited, by id.

members.name: draft
members.description: The text in the reply box. It empties when a reply is sent, even a cancelled one; set it back to restore the text when a server refuses the reply.

members.name: fire
members.description: Dispatches one of the thread's change events; `false` when it was cancelled.

members.name: focusFirst
members.description: Focuses the first of the selectors that matches, in the order given (not document order).

members.name: stopInner
members.description: Inner controls keep their own events: their `input` or field enrolment is not this thread's.

events.description: Cancelable. The user sends a reply (the Reply button, or Ctrl/⌘+Enter).
events.name: comment-add

type.text: CustomEvent<{ id: string | number; body: string }>

events.description: Cancelable. The user saves an edited comment.
events.name: comment-edit

events.description: Cancelable. The user confirms deleting a comment. Deleting the first one is left to the app.
events.name: comment-delete

events.description: Cancelable. The user resolves or reopens the thread.
events.name: resolve-change

type.text: CustomEvent<{ id: string | number; emoji: string; reacted: boolean; count: number }>

events.description: Cancelable. The user adds or removes a reaction on a comment.
events.name: reaction-change
